decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's existing secure messaging, API, and cloud operations capabilities, and its continued standalone presence from 2023 to 2024 suggests enough fit and learning value to retain it.

As a close extension of the firm's established email and messaging infrastructure, it is highly compatible with existing knowledge and can be improved through the firm's in-house R&D and enterprise integration experience.

This product is also closely related to the firm's core communication platform and complements adjacent channels, so the firm is well positioned to interpret early market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
